source: Founder phone tour, relayed by Manager on 2026-09-24

keyboard.doneAction: dismiss keyboard only; no save, send or form submission
keyboard.largeText: toolbar grows with label; do not clip or cover focused content
keyboard.chat: Keep composer, counter and Send above the keyboard; accessory bar must not cover them.

photo.preparingState: photo-preparing is local preparation, not server processing
photo.uploadProgress: Use real upload progress if available. Otherwise indeterminate; the illustration contains no numeric percentage or completion claim.
photo.processing: Indeterminate spinner; do not infer completion from transfer completion or elapsed time.
photo.success: Show photoUploaded only after the application confirms the upload/processing success.
photo.errors: Keep the existing error and retry behavior; this design adds no cancellation, retry policy or backend states.

birthDate.display: localized readable day, month name/abbreviation and year
birthDate.validation: Existing age eligibility, date validation and visibility rules remain unchanged.

ownProfile.tabEntry: view-own-visible or view-own-hidden according to own field visibility

editAction.placement: top right, immediately left of settings

hiddenFields.otherProfile: Continue omitting hidden fields completely; no marker or blank placeholder.
